P25a_NO_EDGE_BENCHMARK.purpose: pass probability of a strategy with ZERO gross edge under Topstep 50K Combine rules (config/prop_firms_v3.json) at the user's MNQ fee $1.22 RT + 1 tick ($0.50) slippage per side
P25a_NO_EDGE_BENCHMARK.model: daily P&L ~ N(0 - costs, sigma) with intraday worst = min(0, pnl) * 1.3; sigma in {150,250,400,600} USD/day; trades per day 1-4 MNQ-equivalent; 5000 block-bootstrap paths; also a 'bold' variant with fat-tailed +R/-1R trade outcomes
P25a_NO_EDGE_BENCHMARK.use: benchmark: a strategy only has a prop edge if its pass probability exceeds this at the same risk level

P25b_US_SESSION_MOMENTUM.hypothesis: In gold, crude and FX futures, the return from the previous day's 15:00 CT close to 09:00 CT (overnight + first US hour) predicts the 09:00-15:00 CT return (continuation).
P25b_US_SESSION_MOMENTUM.rationale: intraday momentum: late-informed / hedging flows trade in the direction of the early move (Gao, Han, Li & Zhou 2018 equities; Elaut, Froemmel & Lampaert 2018 FX; commodities literature). Never tested in this project on non-equity markets.
P25b_US_SESSION_MOMENTUM.signal: s = sign(c_0900CT / c_1500CT(prev) - 1) if |that return| > 0.25 * its trailing 60-day std, else no trade
P25b_US_SESSION_MOMENTUM.execution: enter at open of the 10:00 ET hourly bar (09:00 CT), exit at close of the 15:00 ET bar (15:00 CT); risk-normalised by 20-day std of the 09-15 CT return
P25b_US_SESSION_MOMENTUM.competing: P25c_US_SESSION_REVERSAL = the opposite sign (fade the early move); both evaluated, Holm across the two

gates.DEV: pooled net Sharpe >= 0.5 AND >= 4/6 markets positive
gates.FRESH: pooled net mean > 0 (TopstepX real futures never used by any strategy)

P25b_US_SESSION_MOMENTUM.prop: if FRESH passes: Topstep 50K simulation with micro contracts (MGC, MCL, M6E, M6B; 6J mini) at user fees
